published_ranges._notes: Visible spec block on sovol3d.com PETG 2kg page. Tolerance from Sovol Amazon listing. Drying: Sovol says only 'Please dry PETG filament before printing'; sister brand Comgrow states 70°C >3h (not entered). Density not published. Earlier entry: Nozzle 230-250C, bed 60-80C, speed 50-250mm/s from the sovol3d.com PETG product specification table (confirmed via search-engine extraction of the 'Sovol PETG 3D Printer Filament 6KG' / sovol-petg-3d-filaments-2kg page; sovol3d.com returned HTTP 429 to direct fetches). Tolerance and 1.75mm from Sovol's own Amazon listing title (read directly, B0FMXRV2LY: 'Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm'). No density, drying or fan values published.
